rca of the issue: Original update_candidate handler validated payload.project (raising 400 'Missing project') BEFORE calling _assert_center_access. For any candidate whose 'project' field was empty/null, an out-of-scope center-scoped user would receive 400 instead of 403 — leaking existence and violating the fail-closed golden rule. Reproduction: PATCH /api/candidates/{oos_cid} with {} as cm user (single-center 10751714…). Expected 403, got 400 'Missing project'. Fix: moved _assert_center_access to run immediately after existence check, before project validation.
